race.comment: An even field will end the day over 1860m at BM56 level. LA REEL DEAL (4) won her maiden convincingly at Coleraine just over 3 weeks ago, and he will relish the step up from 1600m to 1860m here. The only query will be the 61.5kg that he has to shoulder, but we think he can win again. PRINCESS SAKIKO (10) has been thereabouts in slightly tougher fields than this recently, and with a drop in class, she should be a top 3 hope. JACKAND (5) battled away fairly well in a better class at Geelong 10 days ago, and he is better placed in this. A wide gate should not be an issue over the longer journey, and he will be hitting the line strongly. Watch for him late. Can win. MANNERHEIM (7) has been battling for form, and will have the blinkers back on for the first time this prep. Keep safe.
